name: omegaClass
line: an outdoor fire station in one cabinet
question: Can one stainless cabinet hold a parrilla, a smoker and a prep station — and let two pitmasters work at once?
body: One wide sealed stainless cabinet that opens into a full outdoor fire station in three zones: a prep + sink counter, a brasero-fed Argentine parrilla, and a vertical rack smoker — sheltered by two lift-up roofs. Designed so a master asador and a master pitmaster can both work it at once. Configure it live, then read the full plan.
alt: omegaClass — a stainless grill that deploys a sheltered fire station
